reading.zh: 从左到右：init 初始化模型，preprocess 预处理，onnx 与 opencv-hog 是两种推理后端，decode 解码输出，observe 发布观测，status 汇报状态；箭头是图像自预处理流向观测。
reading.en: Left to right: init loads the model, preprocess prepares the image, onnx and opencv-hog are two inference backends, decode turns output into boxes, observe publishes the observation and status reports; arrows run from preprocessing to the published observation.
